en.html:
They said a smith becoming a tsurugi turned the soul into steel along with the body. So a true-forged tsurugi might have a mind, but hardly any waves of feeling passed through it. Flat. Supposedly. Normally.

Masamune had nothing to do with normally. Human emotions, full supply, perhaps more than a human.
But now his voice really was steel. Cold and hard.

en.html: Nearly half the wings had been blown away. Bad. Very bad. No continuing flight like this. Put heat into regeneration...◆...as if that would finish in time. The remaining wing armour barely kept us balanced. Probably we would not die on hitting the ground. Good news: the perfectly healthy enemy could then take his time killing us instead. Grounded against airborne: one to three, or one to five. Some people even put the strength ratio at one to ten. In short, not a contest.
en.text:
Nearly half the wings had been blown away.
Bad. Very bad.

No continuing flight like this. Put heat into regeneration...◆...as if that would finish in time.

The remaining wing armour barely kept us balanced. Probably we would not die on hitting the ground. Good news: the perfectly healthy enemy could then take his time killing us instead.

Grounded against airborne: one to three, or one to five. Some people even put the strength ratio at one to ten.
In short, not a contest.
